title: Metal: Hellsinger
summary: Rhythm first-person shooter where attacks, reloads and movement are rewarded for matching the beat of an original heavy-metal soundtrack, combining score-chasing combat with a short campaign.

observations.statement: Rhythm-synchronized shooting is repeatedly praised as the defining mechanic, with staying on beat reinforcing combat flow and scoring.
The heavy-metal soundtrack and vocal performances are among the most consistently praised parts of the game.
Some players report difficulty maintaining the beat or frustration with timed challenge conditions even while liking the core combat.
A reviewed user wanted more replay structures such as an endless mode or freer song selection.

conflicts.statement: The strict beat-driven execution is the main source of flow for many reviewers but also the main mechanical friction for players who struggle with timing.

steam_reviews.query: Steam Community review pages; Russian and non-Russian lanes attempted; accessible index was sparse
